findings: Motus Animi2023,for two saxophonists,17min,Zen-On commission; premiere21December2023 Tokyo Bunka Kaikan Small Hall,Shinichiro Hikosaka and Yuta Hikosaka.

Three movements portray joy,anger and sorrow. Composer explicitly frames work as a bridge toward contemporary music for performers unfamiliar with it,emphasizing gesture and movement. This does not establish beginner difficulty.

Actual score opening specifies1st Alto Saxophone and2nd Alto Saxophone,corroborating Schott instrumentation; Any Saxophone should be reviewed. Preface allows either player to play either part in each movement.

score_observations: Inspected openingpp5–6:3/8,dotted-quarter60,moving to4/4 quarter88 atbar26. Frequent accidentals,triplet subdivisions,thirty-second-note figures,and large register changes appear in both parts.
